headline: Computational inference for proteoforms, glycan traits, and deeper DIA proteome coverage
label: Mass Spectrometry Computational Inference
summary: Imputation-aware proteoform discovery, glycan trait extraction, and narrow-window DIA-TMTpro workflows now pair statistical rigor with depth.
synthesis: The common thread is computational inference applied at the interpretation stage of bottom-up and glycoproteomics workflows, with analysis conventions made explicit rather than fixed. ProteoForge groups co-varying peptides into differential proteoforms within an imputation-aware statistical model benchmarked in bottom-up proteomics, so missing-value handling enters the inference directly. GlycoTraitR imports N-linked glycopeptide spectral matches from search engines and derives glycan structural traits for comparing microheterogeneity across samples. The narrow-window DIA workflow with 18-plex TMTpro labeling on an Orbitrap Astral is an acquisition-side contribution, reporting improved proteome depth over DDA in ovarian cancer tissue. What is new is the pairing of statistically explicit feature definition with higher-throughput acquisition, although these items do not directly test how the two layers interact.
